verdict.rationale: Neon documents creating projects through the CLI (`neon claim create`, which writes `DATABASE_URL` to `.env`) and fully automated project creation through the Neon API. It positions itself as a serverless database that scales with the app and does not charge compute overhead for idle databases, which removes capacity planning. A hands-on user report corroborates that databases become available quickly. Missing for 10: a documented provisioning-time figure ("seconds"), and first-party autoscaling detail beyond page titles showing no compute sizing is needed at creation.

support.subject: As a developer, I can create a ready-to-connect database in seconds through the CLI or API without capacity planning

citations.quote: The CLI writes `DATABASE_URL` (and granted service URLs) to `.env` or `.env.local`
creates a temporary Neon project when there is no Neon account yet
Project creation, configuration, and cleanup are fully automated
Serverless database that scales and branches with your app.
impressed at how quickly databases become available
